0.note: Tim Longest issues page: he has consistently pushed for higher teacher salaries, restoration of master's pay, expansion of the teaching fellows program, and better funding for public schools.

Dave Vella education page: he plans to keep increasing educational opportunities by strengthening vocational programs in school districts, hiring more teachers, increasing their pay, and increasing access to colleges or apprenticeships.
Steve Magie campaign biography: as state representative he has fought to protect and improve Conway's public schools.
John Wyble issues page: we must increase school choice, provide the necessary technology for students, and allow parents to have a greater role in their child's education.
Tim Kelly campaign mission page: in the Michigan House he put families and students first and fought teacher unions in pursuit of full access to better education.
